meta.requirement: Explore Stormterror's Lair (30%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: The Spinning Compass
start.text: ''Someone in a faded guide vest is walking the same loop of broken stone, talking like there's a crowd.''

Uh____is_this_a_tour_.text: Nils: YES! Hi! Welcome to Stormterror's Lair please stay on the path and do not climb anything that looks like it used to be a dragon I have to say that every time.

The_bones_.text:
''You walk past a pile of bones big enough to be a wall.''

Nils: Ah. Yes. The pile. Ancient dragon, rumored to be Dvalin, slain a long time ago. Very educational. Please do not take a souvenir bone, someone did that last week and I am still filling out the form.

dot3.text:
''You feel really uneasy. Nils keeps walking.''

Nils: And if you look to your left... wait. Wait wait wait.

You_okay_.text:
''He holds up a brass compass. The needle is spinning.''

Nils: No no no not now... ugh. The gems are dying. I usually tell people the needle spinning is part of the show but it is not part of the show, the gems are actually dying.

What_gems_.text:
Nils: There's five of them. They seal the center. Nobody knows what for, which is great on a tour, very mysterious, except I can't finish the loop if the compass is drunk.

Nils: I can show you the first one? If you help me repair them I can actually do my job today.

Yeah_I_ll_help.text: Nils: Really? Oh thank god. First one needs twenty Chaos Circuits. I have a vest. I do not have twenty Chaos Circuits.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Repair the first seal with 20 Chaos Circuits at Stormterror's Lair

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Repair the First Seal

Repair_the_First_Seal.text: Nils: This is the first one. Housing's loose, circuits are dead.

Still_looking.text: Nils: Ruin Guards drop them. I don't fight those. That's kind of the whole problem.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Repair the first seal with 20 Chaos Circuits at Stormterror's Lair

I_have_the_circuits.text:
''You slot the circuits in. The gem steadies.''

Nils: Okay that's one. Next wants ten Iron Chunks for the brace. I don't know the technical name. It's iron.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Repair the second seal with 10 Iron Chunks at Stormterror's Lair

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Repair the Second Seal

Repair_the_Second_Seal.text: Nils: Second one's this way. Brace is shot.

I_have_the_iron.text:
''The brace seats. The second gem holds.''

Nils: Two. Third one wants five Crystal Chunks. Don't ask me why, I didn't build it.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Repair the third seal with 5 Crystal Chunks at Stormterror's Lair

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Repair the Third Seal

still_looking.text: Nils: I'll just stand here and pretend this is still a tour.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Repair the second seal with 10 Iron Chunks at Stormterror's Lair

Repair_the_Third_Seal.text: Nils: Yeah this is the crystal one. Looks expensive. Is not working.

Still_looking_.text: Nils: If I start the bone speech again please stop me.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Repair the third seal with 5 Crystal Chunks at Stormterror's Lair

I_have_the_crystal.text:
''The third gem lights. Nils taps his compass. Still spinning.''

Nils: Three. Last two I can't touch. Special fittings. There's a guy in Springvale, Piet, he used to service this stuff. I asked him last month and he told me to get lost.

I_ll_go_to_Springvale.text: Nils: If you can get him up here I'll keep watch. I am very good at standing still. It's like half the job.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Find Piet in Springvale and convince him to help with the last two seals

continues.label: Go to Springvale (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Talk to Piet

Talk_to_Piet.text:
''A man at a workbench is scraping an empty plate with a fork.''

Piet: If you're here about a job, no.

choices.label: I need help with the seals at Stormterror's Lair

I_need_help_with_the_seals_at_Stormterro.text: Piet: Everybody needs help with something. Make it fast.

Offer_a_free_steak.text:
''You set a Perfect Steak on the empty plate.''

Piet: ...did you actually cook this right?

''He eats. He eats all of it.''

Piet: Fine. I'll come. Don't talk on the walk.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring Piet to the fourth seal at Stormterror's Lair

continues.label: Go to Stormterror's Lair (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Bring Piet to the Fourth Seal

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Find Piet in Springvale and convince him to help with the last two seals

Offer_100_silver.text: Piet: Money. Cool. Another stranger waving coins at me like I'm a shop. Go away.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Come back to Piet in Springvale in 3 hours

continues.label: Wait for 3 hours, then do /rpg and click on Talk to Piet

Try_to_talk_to_him.text: Piet: Yeah I know the seals. Yeah I can fix them. No I'm not hiking to a dragon graveyard because you asked nicely. Go away.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Come back to Piet in Springvale in 3 hours

continues.label: Wait for 3 hours, then do /rpg and click on Talk to Piet

Talk_to_Piet_.text: Piet: You again. I said go away.

Bring_Piet_to_the_Fourth_Seal.text:
Piet: Yeah this is junk. Hold that.

''He does something with a tool you do not own. The gem lights.''

Piet: Four. Last one's further in.

''You start walking. Something heavy moves in the stone.''

Piet: Of course. There's a machine. Of course there is.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Defeat the Ruin Guard and Ruin Hunter at the fifth seal

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Fight the Ruin Machines. Defeat 1 [[Ruin Guard]] and 1 [[Ruin Hunter]]

Fight_the_Ruin_Machines.text:
''The machines go still. Piet is already walking toward the gem.''

Piet: Don't celebrate.

''Wind hits. Three big slimes drop in.''

Piet: I hate this place.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Defeat the Large Anemo Slimes at the fifth seal

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Fight the Slimes. Defeat 3 [[Large Anemo Slime]]s

Fight_the_Slimes.text:
''The last gem steadies. Piet wipes his hands on his vest.''

Piet: Done. Take me home. I'm not walking back through that alone.

continues.label: Go to Springvale (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Take Piet back to Springvale

Take_Piet_back_to_Springvale.text: Piet: That's my door. Thanks for the steak. Don't come back unless you have another one.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Return to Nils at Stormterror's Lair

continues.label: Go to Stormterror's Lair (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Talk to Nils

Talk_to_Nils.text:
Nils: You're back. Piet actually came?? Wait.

''He holds the compass up. The needle settles.''

Nils: It's working. It's actually working.

What_s_the_seal_guarding_.text: Nils: I... I don't actually know. I say mysterious center on the tour. I've never gone in. Do you wanna...

____The_Spinning_Compass__Portal_Found.title: Portal Found
____The_Spinning_Compass__Portal_Found.text:
''He takes you past the bones, through a gap the gems were locking. In the middle there's a strange portal, just sitting there.''

Nils: I am not putting this on the brochure.

''He counts silver into your hand, still looking at the portal.''

Nils: That's for the circuits and the hiking and whatever Piet charged you in food.

Nils: I have to rewrite the last ten minutes of the tour.
